origin.rerun: grep -n 'schedule' .github/workflows/guards.yml  # no schedule arm (and no last-graded-sha base in run_guards) = still open

what: Diff-scoped guards have no bounded post-merge run on main. Auto-merged (GITHUB_TOKEN) merge commits start no guards push run. The next push run's before...sha range begins AT the token-merged commit, so that commit's diff is never graded by the diff-scoped guards. main-tree-watch (hourly) grades only the diff-INDEPENDENT rules, by design (run_guards --base main on main diffs against itself). pytest-run got a 30-min backstop in #18240 (scripts/ci/pytest_run_backstop.py: run on HEAD unless a completed full run on an ancestor is followed only by suite-neutral commits). The same shape for guards needs a 'last graded sha' input to run_guards (--base <last fully-graded sha>), which is a design change to run_guards, so it is not folded into #18240.
